sloka: निःसृताः स्म मुनिश्रेष्ठ कान्तारात् रोमहर्षणात् ।अनया तु अवगच्छामि देशस्य सुखवत्तया ॥१-२८-१९॥
transliteration: niḥsṛtāḥ sma muniśreṣṭha kāntārāt romaharṣaṇāt ।anayā tu avagacchāmi deśasya sukhavattayā ॥1-28-19॥

translations.english: O best of acetics, I think we have come out of that awesome (horripilating) forest because of the pleasant feeling experienced in this region. Whose hermitage is this? O Revered one tell me".
